=== PHYSICAL PDF PAGE 41; PRINTED 35 ===
Chapter 5: Signals, Signs, and Markers Texas Driver Handbook
Barrels
Barrels that are engineered to act as an impact cushion reduce the seriousness of crashes. These barrels are usually installed in front 
of a solid obstacle and in areas of high crash frequency.
Hearing Impaired
If you see this flag on the back of a bicycle, slow down, as the bicycle operator may be hearing impaired. This sign may also be 
displayed on vehicles to alert others the driver may be hearing impaired.
Construction and Maintenance Devices
Various traffic control devices are used in construction and maintenance work zones to direct drivers, bicyclists, 
or pedestrians safely through the work zone and to provide for the safety of the workers.
The most commonly used traffic control devices are signs, barricades, vertical panels, drums, cones, tubes,  
flashing arrow panels, and flag individuals. Orange is the basic color for these devices.
When you are in a construction and maintenance work zone, be prepared:
1.  To slow down or stop as you approach workers and equipment
2.  To change lanes
3.  For unexpected movements of workers and equipment
Construction and Maintenance Signs
Construction and maintenance signs are used to alert drivers of unusual or potentially dangerous conditions in or near work zones. 
Most signs in work zones are diamond shaped, but a few are rectangular.
Table 21: Construction and Maintenance Signs
Sign Sign Sign Sign

 Special Note: Special Note:

for violations

changes.new_statement: Impact-cushion barrels lessen crash severity near solid obstacles or frequent-crash areas. Slow for a hearing-impaired flag on a bicycle; on a motor vehicle it alerts others. Expect signs, barricades, panels, drums, cones, tubes, arrow panels and flaggers; prepare to reduce speed or stop, change lanes and react to workers or equipment. Most work signs are diamonds, with some rectangles. Traffic fines double for construction-zone violations when workers are present.
